decision.reason: [ev-6fbb729f3958] is a single changelog line saying only that a regression on flags with spaces between key and value was fixed. It names no flag, so the proposed exposure on "--flag-with-space-separated-value" uses a made-up flag name and cannot be right. The line also does not say which syntax or flags were affected, or which earlier versions had the regression. To build a correct exposure condition, I need the content of PR #10445, or the issue it fixes: which flag syntax broke and which from-versions had the bug.
